market_data.trigger_now: Enterprises often struggle with a lack of telemetry to pinpoint AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant drift in systems and human resources.

raw.what_makes_this_different: narma differentiates itself by focusing on a "Work Graph" to detect employee intent, business value of tasks, and workflow "drift" to automatically generate, deploy, and monitor AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, rather than building new foundation models.
raw.product_description: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layer architecture. The Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) detects employee intent, business value of tasks, and "drift" in workflows. The Execution Layer (Layer 3) is an "Agent Factory" that generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities. The system leverages existing foundation models and focuses on a "Work Graph" to pinpoint resource burn and intercept work for AI assistance.
raw.thesis:
narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. It differentiates itself by focusing on a "Work Graph" to identify and automate high-ROI tasks using existing foundation models. The venture aims to address the challenges enterprises face in quantifying AI savings, ensuring reliable ROI, and managing system and human resource drift. It positions itself as a solution for continuous AI optimization by observing work, deciding optimal AI actions, and continuously auto-building agents. The founder's goal appears to be a growth startup, given the ambition to scale AI automation within enterprises. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the architecture and problem statement defined, but no mention of a prototype, users, or revenue.

Positioning in Value Chain: narma complements existing AI solutions and foundation models by providing an orchestration and optimization layer. It sits *on top* of existing AI infrastructure, enabling enterprises to get more value out of their current investments. It replaces manual processes of identifying and deploying AI automation opportunities and provides continuous monitoring and adaptation, addressing the shortcomings of current ad-hoc AI implementation strategies.
